She grew up in a world most people only hear about in whispers. Her father was a powerful voodoo priest — the man athletes and influential figures came to when they wanted a guaranteed victory. And when the stakes were highest, even at the Super Bowl, they were willing to offer sacrifices to Satan himself to control the outcome.

But that’s only part of her story. From a childhood surrounded by witchcraft and demonic power to a life transformed by the love of Jesus Christ, this is her powerful testimony of deliverance. She shares the darkness she once lived in, the spiritual battles she faced, and the freedom she found in the One who came to set the captives free.
